description: Track documentation repairs against original audit evidence. prepare saves a local baseline and returns a scoped work order; verify reads that baseline and reports resolved, unresolved, review-required, unverified, and new findings. Suppressed advisories remain unresolved. Does not edit documentation or approve decisions. No map required.

baselinePath.description: Original baseline path returned by prepare; required for verify.

checks.description: Optional audit check subset for prepare. Verification always uses the original checks.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

name: mason_repair
